# Pren

> Pren is an accounting service for startups. Expert AI agents keep your books, prepare your business taxes, handle bills and invoices, and build your cash forecasts. A Pren professional handles judgment and review. Plans start at $299 per month.

Pren (usepren.com) is a startup accounting service based in San Francisco, CA. It serves US startups from pre-seed through Series A and beyond: monthly bookkeeping and financial statements, business tax preparation, payroll from your own provider reconciled with your books, bills and invoices, budgets and cash forecasts, and board and fundraising reports. Customers sign up and work with Pren in the Pren app at https://app.usepren.com.

Key facts:
- Website: https://usepren.com/
- Sign up or sign in: https://app.usepren.com/
- Pricing: Pren $299 per month; Pren Plus $799 per month; Custom pricing for more entities or specialist work.
- Supported today: one Delaware or California C corporation operating in California, ordinary USD business activity, up to 50 people, 15 financial accounts and 2,000 imported entries a month. Other profiles, such as LLCs, need an assessed scope.
- How it works: AI agents prepare the work, a Pren professional reviews it, and the founder approves decisions. The included work, full price and first delivery date are agreed before service starts.
- Contact: ryan@usepren.com
- Location: 501 Folsom Street, San Francisco, CA 94105

## Plans

- **Pren** (Pre-seed & seed): $299 per month. Books & business taxes. Monthly books and agreed business-tax returns. Includes: 12 monthly closes per year; Up to 15 financial accounts; 2,000 imported entries per month; Business tax preparation; Reviewed financial statements; Answers, records & exports.
- **Pren Plus** (Series A): $799 per month. Accounting, payroll & planning. Payroll and planning, connected to your books. Includes: Payroll through your own provider, reconciled with your books; 20 new bills + 20 new invoices per month; Budgets & a 13-week cash forecast; A 24-month financial forecast; Hiring & spending scenarios; Quarterly board reports & fundraising prep.
- **Custom** (Growth & beyond): custom pricing. A plan for your company. More people, entities or specialist work. Includes: Services chosen for your company; Additional companies, states & countries; More transactions & specialist work; Agreed services, price & delivery dates.

## Services

- [Monthly bookkeeping](https://usepren.com/services/accounting/): Monthly bookkeeping, reviewed. Current books. Transactions sorted. Accounts reconciled.
- [Business taxes](https://usepren.com/services/taxes/): Business tax preparation. Organized records. Prepared returns. Reviewed before you sign.
- [Payroll, bills & invoices](https://usepren.com/services/payroll/): Payroll, bills and customer invoices. Payroll reconciled. Bills handled. Invoices followed up. With Pren Plus.
- [Cash planning](https://usepren.com/services/cash-planning/): Budget and cash forecasts. See your runway and what your next hire changes.
- [Board & fundraising reports](https://usepren.com/services/fundraising-readiness/): Board and fundraising reports. Organized financials for board meetings and fundraising.
